feature_objects.opening.value: Eda says a swollen joint drips onto her drying shelf. She offers a two-coin refundable knife deposit or a six-coin purchase. Bracing needs ordinary sound wood; an offered demonstration may reveal a more exact fitting method.

feature_objects.joint.value: Firsthand joint inspection: the cross-grain swollen stave leaks onto the one Village drying shelf. An ordinary brace can hold it clear while it still seeps; a matching sound-grain insert can seal this particular joint.

reference_gameplay.offer.value: After your firsthand joint inspection, Eda offers her measured-cooling bench: two stocked sleeves at two coins each, eight one-coin salt packets, a one-coin lesson, and up to three one-coin trials. Ordinary resin setting needs no method. Asking accepts no purchase, practice or debt.

reference_gameplay.buy_sleeve.value: You paid Eda 2 native coins for one actual sleeve. Her finite stock decreased and her purse received the payment. Purchase grants no cooling knowledge.

reference_gameplay.offer_record.value: I offered my existing local cooling skill, two sleeves and eight measured salt packets after the traveler inspected the joint. These finite supplies will not renew on return.
